runnerRetained.name: AC-14 [ED-06, SPK-02 question 4, Platform/SRE (ingress)] — a 15 s HEARTBEAT KEEPS AN IDLE STREAM OPEN across the ingress and any platform proxy, and the EFFECTIVE MAXIMUM STREAM LIFETIME is measured against the intended 60 s. suite: 10.18b — blocked criteria, recorded as skipped and never passed

runnerRetained.name: AC-15 [ED-06, SPK-02 question 5, Platform/SRE (ingress) + backend dev] — RECONNECT WITH Last-Event-ID TO A DIFFERENT API REPLICA restores the current snapshot. The evidence must show the two connections were served by DIFFERENT PODS: a reconnect that happens to land on the same replica proves nothing and is the way this criterion gets reported passed without being tested. Production runs three replicas scaling to six. The design answers this by reading committed state rather than by affinity, and **NO STICKY-SESSION OR SESSION-AFFINITY SETTING MAY BE INTRODUCED TO MAKE IT PASS** — story 10.18b introduced none, and the streaming Ingress it added carries no affinity annotation of any kind. Trading a design property for a deployment workaround would close this criterion by defeating the thing it exists to check.
